This paper describes static voltage stability analysis of American Electric Power Service Corporation network which comprises of 30 bus system.

articleTitle: Plug-in Based System Framework for Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: An authentic software has been executed through plug-in for extended applications. Authors are developing plug-in based system framework for image processing. We are developing image processing software. Additional plug-in can be added for different applications of image processing. Authors are developing a framework in that user can open an image. A user can apply various image operations like color transformation, histogram etc. In this paper, authors aim is to highlight on authors contribution in this field, where authors have created such system in which user can add his own plug-in and gives accurate result.

articleTitle: A Proposed Methodology for Multi-Temporal Image Change Detection by Using Image Stitching Through Pixel Block Localization
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In alteration discovery analysis, image misalignment still remains a pesky issue, although such discovery would be is entirely determined by the accuracy of image registration. If the procedure of alteration detection is done on images that are not aligned properly, problems may accrue in the form of missed or wrong alterations. This, in turn, would have an adverse effect on the correctness of actual change detection. This paper's aim is to propose a methodology about the recognition of change technique that is expected to curtail the influence exerted by improper alignment of images. And to effect this, the method of detecting alternations or changes based on pixel is being advanced, as this suggested method would deal with errors arising out of mis-registration effectively. The technique proposed here involves image stitching by combining two or more images of the same scene as a single larger image. Block matching technique is a way of locating matching blocks in a sequence of image for the purpose of image estimation. To spot the alteration in image, the use of image differencing is being advocated. It is anticipated that the suggested experimental steps would yield a top rate of accuracy.

articleTitle: Design study of N Bit Asynchronous Binary Search Analog to Digital Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: A high speed, low power, and low-resolution Digital Converters are mostly used in high-frequency applications, which converts radio frequency (RF) signals into the digital output for signal processing. A BSADC, an effective compromise between a Flash ADC and a SAR ADC. This paper presents a Binary Search ADC which works on Binary Search Algorithm. This paper compares various Binary search ADC Architecture in order to find a more efficient design for a BSADC and to enhance the throughput of the ADC without increasing its complexity.

articleTitle: Implementation of Data Collection Algorithm based on TDA in WSN Mobile Elements
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Sensor nodes transmit data packets from source to destination in wireless sensor network for that they utilize multi-hop routing. While sending data more energy is consumed. Hence for gathering data in interesting area mobile elements are instigate. Delay to transmit long data is major problem in numerous proposed data collection algorithm. Hence to resolve this problem proposed a data collection algorithm with mobile elements. Here for collecting event packets rely on moving window mechanism mobile elements are dispatched. Hence experimental result shows our proposed system can lower data delay.

articleTitle: Dynamic Features Extraction System of pets on Plants Processing
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In agriculture, pests can destroy the production on land so the need arises to remove pests from soil for better agriculture production. Because for removing these pest requires insecticides and that are costly some farmers cannot afford that. So preventing the pest while it is very small in quantity is better. So supervision of farmland pests is a crucial to spray agriculture in a timely and appropriate manner, which gives guarantee of good production in agriculture. Here we introduced some methods that are required for gaining dynamic characteristics of pests by utilizing machine vision. Generally these characteristics are gathered from farmland. First step is pests and the background images are categorized by using color feature and thresholding methods. Second step is applied Gaussian filtering to obtain the shape features and the number i.e count of pests. Lastly frame-to-frame differencing method is utilized to get the quantity of pest motion. The experimental results shows that the 99% accuracy rate. It can provide quantitative information of pest activity for plant protection personnel. Existing methods not able to monitor large scale land or crop. Proposed system utilized in large-scale crop pest supervision.

articleTitle: Exploring Pain Insensitivity Inducing Gene ZFHX2 by using Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Chronic pain is one of the major health issues which affects wellbeing of casualties ranging from orthopedic damages to unbearable cancer pain. Though analgesics aids in reducing pain sensitization, it has its own defect of causing side effects such as drug resistance and habit formation. Evolutionary research has evidenced that by mutating "ZFHX2" gene, one can achieve pain insensitivity. This work emphases on 1) Designing an early mutation detection tool to identify the presence of pain inducing gene ZFHX2 among various patients from pathological biopsy images using deep convolution neural network. 2) Pharmacogenomic analysis comprising of genomics, epigenomics, metagenomics, environmental genomics has been performed in ZFHX2 gene to identify genetic signature, one of the reasons behind causing chronic pain. 3) Block chain algorithm has been used to secure valuable patient clinical data obtained from pharmacogenomic and other analysis to maintain records in order to avoid clinical theft.

articleTitle: Extension of the Lexicon Algorithm for Sarcasm Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Lexicon algorithm is used to determine the sentiment expressed by a textual content. This sentiment might be negative, neutral or positive. It is possible to be sarcastic using only positive or neutral sentiment textual contents. Hence, lexicon algorithm can be useful but yet insufficient for sarcasm detection. It is necessary to extend the lexicon algorithm in order to come out with systems that would be proven efficient for sarcasm detection on neutral and positive sentiment textual contents. In this paper, two sarcasm analysis systems both obtained from the extension of the lexicon algorithm have been proposed for that sake. The first system consists of the combination of a lexicon algorithm and a pure sarcasm analysis algorithm. The second system consists of the combination of a lexicon algorithm and a sentiment prediction algorithm.

articleTitle: Simplified Model of DFIG in Wind Integrated Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Due to increase in demand of electricity and due to limitations of conventional energy sources, renewable energy sources are coming up to take their share in the energy mix. The progress of technology has made wind as a promising supplementary energy source and wind power plants are being installed all over the world to support the conventional system. Consequently, contribution of wind power in power system is going up at higher rate, and it has become important to know that how wind power alters the parameters of the power system. There are variety of generators that are employed for wind power generation like SCIG, DFIG and SG. Owing to the advantages such as maximum power tracking, variable speed operation, independent control of active and reactive power DFIG is the most commonly used technology. The paper describes working of DFIG and its simplified model that can be used in the study of wind integrated power system. The paper describes effective use of a double-fed induction generator (DFIG) for variable speed wind power generation.

articleTitle: Analysis of Novel Recommendation Engine Based on Simulated Annealing Based Clustering
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: From past decades, recommendation plays an essential role in information retrieval process and in mining the large amount of available data. Users are facing significant challenges in information retrieval process and they could navigate these information in an efficient way. There are many clustering techniques. K-means is one of the simplest of all the clustering techniques. In this paper we are focusing on the analysis and design of a recommendation system using simulated annealing based clustering model. Simulated [1] is used to solve the problem of local minima. Simulated annealing can be used to locate the cluster centers. Simulated annealing mechanism [1] is used to locate the cluster centers. This is mainly used as a part of code optimization of k-means. One advantage of kmeans is that it is used to cluster large datasets and its performance increases proportionally with the large number of datasets.

articleTitle: Arduino microcontroller based Cashline Security System based on vein recognition Using Dactylography Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In recent times, Cashline Systems are highly used for most of the bank transactions. Cashline system security is becoming more and more important in all aspects. On other hand the ATM frauds such as Duplicating ATM cards and card skimming were increased. To overcome such frauds dactylography technology is used in the proposed system. The advantage of the dactylography technology results on an entirely card free transaction. Even for the identical twins, the finger vein pattern is matchless. The width of the vein may be changed due to temperature changes or blood pressure but the centre line become stable. Then the extracted line will be used for the future identification purpose. The cashline system is to increase authenticity, confidentiality as well as user trust towards ATM transaction. After the analyzation of finger vein of the authenticated person, the next step is followed by means of the analyzed one's finger vein matching with the recorded vein pattern of the related banks database. Then high security level GSM module will generate an OTP and sends it to the authorized users mobile then followed by entering the OTP to the ATM machine, the verification is done and then further transaction process is followed.

articleTitle: Fault Tolerance in VLSI Circuit with Reducing Rollback Cost using FSM
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In this generation, the revolutionary growth in nanometer technologies brought the drastic change in reduction of device size, increase in complexity, increasing operating speed and decrease in power consumption, which are more sensitive to various kinds of problems. In a combinational logic to protect the faults which are transient are not considered generally as this logic has a common hurdle to stop the faults propagation. In this architecture, there are three cover-up factors used in the process of electrical, logical, and window latch. With these factors, as the industry of processors progress in these days, the chances of generation of transient faults as well as the latches on subsequent element is reduced. Solutions that insulate the whole design are usually very expensive. So that, to implement the rollback, a fixed rollback of K-cycle or a rollback with checkpoint is used. This paper proposes a hardware architecture and the implementations of algorithm, which cut downs the rollback rate in all kind of circuits.

articleTitle: —Multiple Cluster-Android lock Patterns (MALPs) for Smart Phone Authentication‖
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: This paper proposes the implementation of progressive authentication service in smart android mobile phone. In this digital era, massive amount of work can be done in the digital form using the smart devices like smart phone , laptop, Tablets, etc. The number of smartphone users approx. reach to 299.24 million, as per the recent survey report [1] in 2019 this count will reach 2.7 billion and after 3 years, this count will increase up to 442.5 million. This article includes a cluster based progressive smart lock with a dependent combination that is short and more secure in nature. Android provides smart lock facilities with the combination of 9 dot, 6dot, 5dot, 4dot and 1-9 number. By using this mobile phone user will be able to generate pattern lock or number password for authentication. This is a single authentication system, this research paper includes a more secured multiple cluster based pattern match system.

articleTitle: Classification of Environmental Resources Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The large amount of knowledge that is structured and unstructured data/information that has been overloaded on the business day by day. However, knowledge is not vital but the data clustering is very important. A huge knowledge is generated anytime and therefore the quantity of the information is approaching a massive data level. articleTitle: Sigmoid based Adaptive Noise Estimation Method for Speech Intelligibility Improvement
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The requirement of noise spectrum is necessary to make a reliable speech enhancement system. The key factor is both frequency and time dependent smoothing constant, which is responsible to update the noise spectrum. Generally, in the SPP (Speech Presence Probability) method the smoothing constant is computed by using recursive averaging approach due to this required smoothed version of noise spectrum is not achieved which leads to degrade the speech quality. Hence, in this paper sigmoid function is used as a smoothing parameter, which depends upon a posteriori SPP (speech presence probability). The characteristics of this function are more flexible due to which the decisions will be too soft to update the noise power spectrum. Moreover, independent adjustment of slope and mean of the sigmoid function provides appropriate trade-off between the underestimation and overestimation of the noise. On the behalf of intelligibility and quality of the enhanced signal the accomplishment of the propound method is evaluated by using objective measures. It is clearly shown that in simulation results the proposed method is much reliable than the reference approaches.

articleTitle: An Optimized LDAE Approach over CTM-SVM for Analyzing Prediction of Violence on Cyber Post
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: This research paper can effectively contribute towards profiling the people from the list of target audiences, and then develops a messaging strategies to influence them. articleTitle: 16nm CMOS Technology based Fast Ring Oscillator for Fast Computing and Mathematical Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Oscillators play an important role as a major component of all digital, optical devices and the communication systems. The invention of integrated circuit has reduced the size of the electronic devices. On the other hand, one of the most widely manufactured integrated circuit is always a ring oscillator. A ring oscillator circuit can be defined as a closed loop circuit which is made up of inverter stages in odd number and that uses a positive feedback mechanism. It is to be noted that the ring oscillators output always swings around two voltages levels namely HIGH and LOW. Even though ring oscillators are used by the foundries on every wafers of the semiconductor in order of priority to examine the delay associated with the gate, but they have a vital use in the construction of Phase Locked Loops and Signal Generators. In this paper, 5-stage CMOS Ring oscillator is implemented using spice tools with Predictive Technology Model 16nm technology to obtain the temperature effects.

articleTitle: Wearable Exoskeleton Assisted Rehabilitation in Multiple Sclerosis by Using Conventional Control Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: An ambulatory model with humanoid robot RH-2 can perform distinctive assignments in a joint effort with PID controller with proper utilization of the different values of human in working environments is presented in this paper. In human-robot, we are using the linear control system to initiate a single inverted pendulum. Humanoid stride is frequently displayed with different forms of the modified pendulum, for example, 2D and 3D linear reversed pendulums. Author Keywords: Linear control function and Walking control with different responses

articleTitle: Auto Adaptive Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Differential Evolution algorithm has proved to be effective and best method for solving various optimization challenges. It has been proved to be rather cumbersome to manually set control parameters in DE. This paper sketch a new variant of the DE algorithm that provides an environment to auto-adjust the control parameters settings. For the past years, DE has captured the attention in many practical cases. It makes use of a few control parameters that are bound to the same value throughout the evolutionary process. Manual control parameters setting is a time-consuming process, so the proposed work provides a reliable, accurate and fast technique to optimize numerical function. This work is tested against various numerical set functions. Final results show that this proposed algorithm performs a cut above when compared with the classical Differential Evolution algorithm, and the other control parameter setting variant of DE considered in the literature.

articleTitle: Analysis of Metacrawler approach for URL based DUST removal by knowledge engineering systems
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Multiple copies of URLs gathered by the web crawlers responsible for pages with similar or near about to similar content. Few pages combined by the web crawlers consist of similar content. Different URLs with Similar Text are generally known as DUST. Result of this is crawl data, to store the data and use such duplicated data results in building of less quality marking, waste of resources and destitute naive user experiences.To study with such problem, multiple studies have been observed. Previous studies focus only on URL based DUST removal .The proposed method removes content depended DUST and URL based DUST. To crawl the documents we are using a new method of metacrawler which fetches results from three Search engine. We are going to compare each website content with the other linked content to remove duplicates using k- gram paraphrased technique.

articleTitle: Analysis of a Data Mining Based Student Data Collection
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Throughout the years, a few factual instruments have been utilized to break down and anticipate understudies' execution from various perspectives. One of the greatest difficulties for advanced education today is to foresee the ways of understudies through the instructive procedure. Information mining techniques are regularly executed at cutting edge colleges today to break down accessible information and extricate data and learning to achieve a basic leadership. Training is the foundation of any nation and it is critical to enhance the instructive quality of the nation. There are different strategies and difficulties in transit, and the utilization of innovations like PCs, shrewd rooms, projectors, and eBooks. However, these resources are helpful just when we know which understudy needs which sort of asset or, as such, in the event that we can foresee the aftereffects of understudies, we can enhance results and decline drop out proportion. In our exploration, we utilized Data Mining in instruction to enhance the after effects of the schools. In this examination paper, we have clarified information mining, its helpfulness in instruction.

articleTitle: Development of Real Time Life Secure and Tracking System for Swimmers
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In today's scenario, there are risks at every moment in our life. People rambling around are found insecure, especially at remote outdoor locations where there is no rescue services provided. One of these scenarios is an aquatic environment such as waterfalls, lakes, trekking, remote locations, water parks, swimming pools, beaches, etc. Many lives are at risks in spite of lifeguard resources. This paper reports a developed real time life secure and tracking system for swimmers. This proposed prototype system monitors the individual's situation in any aquatic environment especially near beaches. This approach consists of three main modules namely, wearable module, standstill and monitoring system. Biomedical approach is used for detection of life threatening incidents. This wearable device uses several sensors to measure different vital physiological parameters of human body and sends an immediate wireless signal to the lifeguards to provide rescue service to the individuals in danger. This device sends an alarm to a receiver unit besides this, there is also a LED which blinks in any chancy situations which is connected to the standstill system and also the monitoring system. The wearable device is battery operated. A prototype of this system is tested with good results.

articleTitle: Hardware Implementation of a High Step up DC-DC Converter Using Photovoltiac System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: A high step up DC input voltage is a most critical requirement of various electrical applications. A high step up DC DC converter using photovoltaic system is a worthy solution of this need. Due to coupled inductor with a capacitor charge in parallel and discharge in series which increase the voltage transfer gain. this converter can accomplish high duty ratio with high step up voltage gain. Also voltage stress on main power switch can be reduced by minimizing the conduction losses and improving efficiency. This paper has incorporated technique for hardware implementation of a high step up DC DC converter using photovoltaic system. In this project coupled inductor with switching capacitor technique are developed to make hardware circuit for input of 12v from the PV panel, output voltage of 100v across the load and power of 354W. Finally, to check its performance the prototype circuit also developed.

articleTitle: Portable Weather Station Using GUI
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The paper gives advanced solution for monitoring of the weather conditions. In this project we are putting together a Weather Station using a variety of sensors [15]. The platform being used is an EduArm board using wifi module. This will provide communications to the sensor [10] .A hardware module based on wireless technology, which measures temperature, air, wind. The sensors chosen for this project are based on the interface method they use and the available inputs on the EduArm. The data collected from sensor displayed on EduArm[14] is LPC1768 based micro controller and also sends the sensor data into the PC by using Serial port. By sending data from device to server by defining protocol and send data over WIFI to server. This data is collected by application interface which runs on PC connected to EduArm and wifi module. Observing the air samples, forcasting the weather, and observing the work behind warning people about the effects of disaster.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Human-computer interface based Cognitive Model for Examine the Skill Factor of Students
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In this paper, a software is designed and developed to organize an ability test which has the ability to present the content on the screen. The software can be developed based on the cognitive model using Keystroke-Level Model (KLM) and cognitive complexity theory whcih helps in illustarting the usability metrics. The proposed software emerges as a real-time application, to conduct test in order to evaluate the skill level of the students by administering a questionnaire that contains three different types of abilities such as numerical ability, logical reasoning and perceptual speed. Basically for higher education, the students will come from different environments such as rural area, city area and metro politician city after completing their school education. So, the system needs to analyze the skill level of the students and identify the particular skill where the individual needs particular attention. The task performance of students can be retrieved from their laboratory test with end user on the basis of user interface design. The software is developed particularly to examine the task performance and to determine the exact plan using usability testing to collect the overall quantitative data. The results obtained can be analysed with a Correlation analysis model.

Author Keywords: KeystrokeLevel Model (KLM) and Cognitive Complexity theory

articleTitle: A new approach to ROI based image compression using simple sliding window spatial filter
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: By reducing the file size, the number of images stored in the given amount of hard disk can be increased and the time required to send images over the internet has been reduced. Image compression is the common and adaptive method used for reducing all the chunks in our day to day life. There are many existing techniques and protypes available for compression. This paper deals with the special concepts on image compression using simple sliding window spatial filter or mean filter. The desired region can be selected using ROI from the image which can be processed for further compression of images. The proposed method uses DCT followed by the suitable encoding techniques. Various combinations of compression applied to come across the best one.

articleTitle: Review on Design & Testing of CCD Detector Data Generation & Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In this review paper, a CCD detector is used to capture the image of the object in dim level of light. The video signal coming from the detector is fed into the video processor which remove the intrinsic noise from the signal, a 0dB to 36dB PGA is inbuilt in processor which is adjusted by programming the PGA register and finally, convert the analog signal into digital by 12-bit ADC. The video processor consists the different kind of registers like control register, ADC register, PGA register, CLPDM, SCLK, OE register etc. These registers are need a clock pulse to perform the specific task and that clock pulse is generated in LabVIEW tool. A PXI card is used for data generation & Acquisition system. The generated clocks are passed to the video processor according to the pin configuration of video processor. Finally, a 12-bit of digital output is generated.

articleTitle: Implementation Rooftop PV using Reconfigure Solar Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: To control the heat temperature in smart home, lend cooling method was designed based on the reconfigurable single stage inverter topology. It will be perform in both dc to dc version and dc to cooling version. The dc to cooling version called as hybrid method and it suits both cooling and dc machines. The proposed innovative inverter topology helps to sort the sun based home equipment's structure and provide the smart framework in microgrid systems.

Author Keywords: Photo voltaic cell and Solar cell

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Image Classifier using CNN
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Surely there has been no time in history where the lived lives of people have changed more dramatically due to the emergence of Artificial Intelligence. Various research and development has taken place over the years on computer vision which is a branch of AI. AI disciplines like a vision system is applied in various fields like self driving cars, face detection by social media apps and law enforcement softwares, google lens and so on. This paper deals with design and implementation of an efficient way of training a GPU using python libraries to process and classify an image. The design is profoundly described along with its performance efficiency. The image processing techniques presented in this paper includes the concept of neural networks and deep learning.

articleTitle: Design of Microstrip Antenna Array and Analysis of different Beamforming techniques for mm-wave MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: This project work is focusing on the design and simulation of array antenna that operates in the mm wave frequency band and also analyze and implement the beamforming technique suitable for the proposed antenna design. The optimum weights calculated from the LMS Algorithm are used to excite the antenna array in ANSYS HFSS to observe the beamforming and the radiation pattern in the direction of desired signal. The obtained results were analyzed and compared with the theoretical values. The result consists of the measure of various parameters that are required to analyse the performance of an antenna like return loss, gain, directivity and bandwidth. . The antennas are implemented in ANSYS HFSS and antenna characteristics are compared based on the Return loss, VSWR, 3D polar plot and radiation pattern which are tabulated. These parameters were also observed for an 8, 16, 32, 64-element antenna array and a significant increase in gain and directivity was observed. All simulations are performed on MATLAB.

articleTitle: Smart Building with Minimum Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Nowadays energy crisis is the main problem that we are facing. By reducing the consumption and increasing the dependency on reliable energy sources are the remedies to overcome this problem. So many technologies are developing to utilize this reliable energy sources. Recent studies clarify that the usage of coolers and air conditioners are exponentially increasing. This results in an increased energy consumption and pollution. To overcome this challenge, we are designing a smart air conditioning system for a building. An air conditioning system with Peltier modules is introduced here. Both cooling and heating effect are utilized. Sensors are used to sense the atmospheric temperature and temperature of conditioned air which is trapped inside an air trapping system. LDR is used to measure the light intensity and accordingly the position of window is adjusted using a servomotor. Energy required for the operation of the system is provided by a solar panel. The whole process is controlled by using microcontroller.

articleTitle: Analyse and Design a micro strip spiral monopole antenna with and without indicator
publicationTitle: 2019 3rd International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In this work we portray the investigation and structure of configurable planar radio wire that can work in the WIFI of 2400 MHz and in the WLAN of 6400 MHz that is likewise in understanding with the expected parameters which is to be utilized for Cognitive applications. The radio wire was structured as a plane square winding that utilizes small scale strip innovation and the reconfigurability was made along with an inductor. Reconfigurability can be accomplished by utilizing PIN diode switches or by utilizing varactor diode / MEMS switches. A broad investigation of a Planer Inverted-Field radio wire (PIFA)was displayed to structure three resounding frequencies to cover GSM, DCS and DMB applications and it was accounted for that two collapsed parts, which can be added to the principle PIFA to make the two groups, here we are utilizing Inductor to accomplish the Re configurability.
